edits.inserted_paragraph: **Alignment completion checkpoint, 6 October 2026:** the [updated account](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/ALIGNMENT-AND-GOVERNANCE.md#the-connected-account-after-the-finite-succession-result) now credits accepted recording, acquired evaluation, fresh correction and actual succession. [Composition](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/foundation-assessment/ALIGNMENT-COMPOSITION-CHECKPOINT.md), [evidence](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/foundation-assessment/ALIGNMENT-EVIDENCE-CHECKPOINT.md) and [independent completion review](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/foundation-assessment/ALIGNMENT-COMPLETION-REVIEW.md) reconcile constructed, empirical and ethical support without treating them as one implemented arrangement. Exact prior versions preserve the superseded statuses. This advances the integrated statement and scope accounting; prospective plasticity, substantive concern/wisdom and the full alignment/governance objective remain ongoing.

**Connected alignment account, 6 October 2026:** the [updated assessment](unified-2026-10-05/ALIGNMENT-AND-GOVERNANCE.md#the-connected-account-after-the-finite-succession-result) follows external dependence through acquired knowledge and evaluative use to justified application, correction and succession. It credits the accepted finite joins and distinguishes them from ethical warrant and a practical learned-AI/institutional method. The [unchanged completion requirements](unified-2026-10-05/ALIGNMENT-COMPLETION.md) now identify the remaining claim-specific work without reopening completed interfaces or adding an unlimited apparatus requirement.

**Alignment composition and scope checkpoint, 6 October 2026:** [the connected application account](ALIGNMENT-AND-GOVERNANCE.md#the-connected-account-after-the-finite-succession-result) integrates accepted consequential learning, evaluative influence and actual succession with the separately defended application, governance and strategic interfaces. The [completion reconciliation](ALIGNMENT-COMPLETION.md) preserves the existing five/seven requirements, credits local closures and distinguishes actual shared histories from transported contracts and empirical observations. Evaluative origin, substantive justified application/revision and the remaining integrated/practical claims are still open. This advances the common statement and dependency accounting; it supplies no new mechanism, empirical result or whole-foundation acceptance.

**Current alignment completion checkpoint, 6 October 2026:** [composition](ALIGNMENT-COMPOSITION-CHECKPOINT.md), [evidence](ALIGNMENT-EVIDENCE-CHECKPOINT.md) and [independent completion review](ALIGNMENT-COMPLETION-REVIEW.md) support the updated [assessment](../../../../theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/ALIGNMENT-AND-GOVERNANCE.md) and [completion contract](../../../../theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/ALIGNMENT-COMPLETION.md).
